records.context: The ``activation`` workflow remains distinct from machine-learning classification model training: it uses its own settings form, Run action, console, and hyperparameter-search structured-data name, and :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` dispatches it to ``generate_activation_map``. The Classify masthead opens that workflow as a folded page so attribution results remain associated with the trained model without combining the two workflow processing sessions.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.activation#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ``activation`` workflow remains distinct from classifier training: it uses its own settings form, Run action, console, and hyperparameter-search key, and :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` dispatches it to ``generate_activation_map``. The Classify masthead opens that workflow as a folded page so attribution results remain associated with the trained model without combining the two pipeline runs.
records.translation: O fluxo de trabalho ``activation`` permanece separado do treinamento do classificador: ele usa seu próprio formulário de configurações, sua ação Run, seu console e sua chave de busca de hiperparâmetros, e :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.resolve_pipeline_entry` o despacha para ``generate_activation_map``. O cabeçalho de Classify abre esse fluxo como uma página recolhida, para que os resultados de atribuição continuem associados ao modelo treinado sem combinar as duas execuções do pipeline.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Annotator Agreement — agreement between the annotation columns of one database.
records.translation: Annotator Agreement — concordância entre as colunas de anotação de um banco de dados.

records.context: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same extracted image regions therefore leave two columns side by side, and this application view reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same crops therefore leave two columns side by side, and this screen reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.translation: O app Annotate grava uma coluna ``INTEGER`` por rodada em ``png_list``. Duas pessoas rotulando os mesmos recortes deixam, portanto, duas colunas lado a lado, e esta tela informa se elas concordam, e em quais linhas divergem, antes que qualquer um dos conjuntos seja usado como verdade de referência.

records.translation: **κ nunca é citado sozinho.** A concordância percentual bruta, o número de linhas comparadas, o número de abstenções e o motivo pelo qual κ é indefinido (quando é) aparecem todos na tela ao lado dele. records.source: Ordering matters throughout and is the reason for the length. The live preview watches ``src`` and can only be wired once both panels exist, because the settings panel owns the field and the runtime panel owns the preview. The category hints have the same constraint in reverse. The page-surface sweep runs on every route, not only where a backdrop was installed: with the ambient preference off, skipping it left every layout container carrying the blanket window fill, which is what made the settings half a solid slab.
records.translation: A ordem importa do começo ao fim e é o motivo da extensão. A pré-visualização ao vivo observa ``src`` e só pode ser conectada quando os dois painéis existem, porque o painel de configurações é dono do campo e o painel de execução é dono da pré-visualização. As dicas de categoria têm a mesma restrição no sentido inverso. A varredura das superfícies da página é executada em todas as rotas, não só onde um fundo foi instalado: com a preferência de ambiente desativada, pulá-la deixava todos os contêineres de layout com o preenchimento geral da janela, e era isso que fazia a metade das configurações parecer um bloco sólido.

Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.
records.translation: Os dois eventos de paleta contam, e é exatamente por isso que isto funciona. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — que é onde :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` termina — entrega ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **apenas aos widgets de nível superior** (Qt 6.11, verificado); todo filho, incluindo cada AppScreen dentro da pilha de MainWindow, recebe ``PaletteChange`` em vez disso. records.context: Lists and tuples are not a corner case. Classify's ``src`` is list-valued and regression's ``count_data``, ``score_data`` and ``paired_data`` are too, and ``utils.load_settings`` turns any CSV cell starting with ``[``, ``(`` or ``{`` into a real Python container. An earlier version of this method tested ``isinstance(value, str)`` and skipped everything else, which skipped exactly the two modules whose loaders never write a local path as a fallback -- so for those the publisher's path was the panel's only source of truth. Containers are walked.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.reanchor_example_paths#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: LISTS AND TUPLES ARE NOT A CORNER CASE. Classify's ``src`` is list-valued and regression's ``count_data``, ``score_data`` and ``paired_data`` are too, and ``utils.load_settings`` turns any CSV cell starting with ``[``, ``(`` or ``{`` into a real Python container. An earlier version of this method tested ``isinstance(value, str)`` and skipped everything else, which skipped exactly the two modules whose loaders never write a local path as a fallback -- so for those the publisher's path was the panel's only source of truth. Containers are walked.
records.translation: LISTAS E TUPLAS NÃO SÃO UM CASO EXTREMO. O ``src`` de Classify é uma lista, assim como ``count_data``, ``score_data`` e ``paired_data`` da regressão, e ``utils.load_settings`` transforma qualquer célula de CSV que comece com ``[``, ``(`` ou ``{`` em um contêiner Python real. Uma versão anterior deste método testava ``isinstance(value, str)`` e ignorava todo o resto, o que ignorava justamente os dois módulos cujos carregadores nunca gravam um caminho local como alternativa -- então, para eles, o caminho de quem publicou era a única fonte de verdade do painel. Os contêineres são percorridos.

records.context: Most of the per-path work is not new. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` already picks the deepest recorded suffix that EXISTS below the current root, so a rewrite is only made when the reconstructed path is really there; it is tried first and its answer preferred. What it cannot do is the root itself -- its resolution needs a suffix to match, and ``src`` pointing at the plate folder has none, which is the reported case. So a screen gets one animated background or none, never both.
records.translation: Todas as telas de módulo, **exceto** as que já animam algo próprio — o que hoje é exatamente :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. A chuva de Sequencing é *sobre* sequenciamento: bases caindo atrás da tela que mapeia leituras para códigos de barras. Colocar uma segunda animação, sem relação, atrás dela entraria em conflito — dois movimentos independentes disputando os mesmos pixels, nenhum legível, e dois timers de animação rodando na única tela que já tinha um. Então uma tela recebe um fundo animado ou nenhum, nunca os dois.

records.context: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the software job list reaches it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.batch#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the queue reaches it.
records.translation: **Os trabalhos são validados quando são adicionados, não quando são executados.** Um trabalho cujo arquivo de configurações está ausente, cujo ``src`` está grafado errado ou cujo módulo é exclusivo da GUI é recusado no botão Add, com o motivo exibido no próprio painel, em vez de falhar quando a fila chega a ele.

records.context: The run uses a worker. **Execution model:** completion returns to the GUI thread. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *inside the worker thread*; therefore each receiver that changes a widget uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.batch#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The run happens off the GUI thread, and its completion handler comes back onto it.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *in the worker thread*; every widget-mutating receiver therefore uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.translation: **A execução acontece fora da thread da GUI, e seu tratador de conclusão volta para ela.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` é emitido *na thread de trabalho*; por isso, todo receptor que altera widgets usa uma conexão enfileirada explícita para um método vinculado deste widget da thread da GUI.

records.source: Every cell of the matrix is clickable, and clicking one asks :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` for exactly the crops that cell counted, so "43 uninfected called infected" opens those 43 crops. The analysis behind it is in :mod:`spacr.confusion`, which has no Qt in it; this file is the table, the two lists and the buttons.
records.translation: Toda célula da matriz é clicável, e clicar em uma pede a :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` exatamente os recortes que essa célula contou, então "43 uninfected called infected" (43 não infectados classificados como infectados) abre esses 43 recortes. A análise por trás está em :mod:`spacr.confusion`, que não tem Qt; este arquivo é a tabela, as duas listas e os botões.

records.context: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classifier_evaluation#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.translation: Duas listas por célula, não uma. O modelo estar **seguro** e errado é evidência contra a *anotação*; o modelo estar **inseguro** e errado é evidência sobre a *fronteira*. São diagnósticos diferentes, com correções diferentes, então são abertos separadamente e nunca misturados em uma única lista ordenada por confiança, em que a distinção desaparece em algum ponto no meio da rolagem.

records.context: Each cell is also broken down per microplate sample position and per laboratory microplate, which shows where the errors came from: 43 errors spread over 20 microplate sample positions point to the model, 43 errors from one microplate sample position point to that microplate sample position.

records.source: Each cell is also broken down per well and per plate, which shows where the errors came from: 43 errors spread over 20 wells point to the model, 43 errors from one well point to that well.
records.translation: Cada célula também é detalhada por poço e por placa, o que mostra de onde vieram os erros: 43 erros espalhados por 20 poços apontam para o modelo; 43 erros de um único poço apontam para esse poço.

records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.
records.translation: Uma campanha de triagem são dezenas de placas executadas ao longo de semanas, e a análise pressupõe que os controles se comportam da mesma forma todas as vezes. A identificação de hits, a normalização por placa e o Z' são todos medidos em relação a eles, então, quando os controles derivam, todos os resultados posteriores se deslocam junto, sem nenhum aviso — a análise normaliza para os controles que receber.

records.context: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on application view and the chart in a report cannot disagree.

This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on screen and the chart in a report cannot disagree.
records.translation: Tudo o que é numérico vem de :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, que não tem Qt e documenta o raciocínio de cada decisão — sobretudo a central, de que o sigma vem da amplitude móvel média dividida por d2 e nunca do desvio padrão da série, porque o SD é inflado exatamente pela deriva que o gráfico existe para detectar. A caixa não vem marcada e não é um simples OK, porque a exclusão não pode ser desfeita.

records.context: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of extracted image regions must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the main GUI execution path, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on application view — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.data_manager.ConfirmDeleteDialog#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of crops must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the GUI thread, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on screen — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.translation: O diálogo é preenchido em duas etapas. A lista de arquivos não é armazenada no plano: cada chamada a ``file_list`` executa ``os.walk`` sobre cada diretório candidato, porque um plano para um projeto com milhões de recortes não deve carregar milhões de strings. Fazer isso em ``__init__`` colocaria uma varredura recursiva completa do projeto do usuário na thread da GUI, justamente no momento em que ele está esperando uma janela aparecer — e, em um compartilhamento adormecido, só o primeiro stat da varredura pode levar vinte segundos enquanto a montagem acorda. Por isso, o diálogo abre com a metade que não precisa de nada do disco (os totais, cada candidato, cada item mantido e seu motivo), e a lista de arquivos chega depois. Nada é descartado: o usuário ainda lê cada caminho antes que qualquer coisa seja excluída, e é por isso que a confirmação fica desabilitada até a lista estar na tela — ou, quando a varredura falha, até :meth:`_on_listing_failed` ter informado isso no lugar da lista. A caixa nunca é habilitada enquanto a lista mostra um texto provisório.

records.translation: Uma colisão é INFORMADA, não resolvida. records.context: Nothing here touches the file on the main GUI execution path. The read executes on a background execution unit -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` into pandas measures 1.5 s for a 200 000-row measurement table on a warm local SSD -- and listing the tables runs there too, even though one ``sqlite_master`` query costs 0.4 ms, because that cost holds only for a disk that answers. Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. Picking a measurements.db off a sleeping share, or dropping a project folder that resolves onto one, would freeze the whole window with no traceback.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.graph_builder.GraphBuilderScreen.load_path#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Nothing here touches the file on the GUI thread. The read runs on a worker thread -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` into pandas measures 1.5 s for a 200 000-row measurement table on a warm local SSD -- and listing the tables runs there too, even though one ``sqlite_master`` query costs 0.4 ms, because that cost holds only for a disk that answers. Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. Picking a measurements.db off a sleeping share, or dropping a project folder that resolves onto one, would freeze the whole window with no traceback.
records.translation: Nada aqui toca o arquivo na thread da GUI. A leitura é executada em uma thread de trabalho -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` para o pandas leva 1.5 s para uma tabela de medições de 200 000 linhas em um SSD local aquecido --, e a listagem das tabelas também é executada lá, embora uma consulta a ``sqlite_master`` custe 0.4 ms, porque esse custo só vale para um disco que responde. Medido em uma estação de trabalho, um único ``stat`` sob ``/nas_mnt`` -- uma montagem ``autofs`` cujo compartilhamento estava adormecido -- não tinha retornado depois de vinte segundos, e ``sqlite3.connect`` abre o arquivo antes de conseguir ler um byte de ``sqlite_master``. Escolher um measurements.db em um compartilhamento adormecido, ou soltar uma pasta de projeto que se resolve para um, congelaria a janela inteira sem nenhum traceback.

records.context: Hyperparameter search panel, built like the Live Preview panel.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Hyperparameter search panel, built like the Live Preview panel.
records.translation: Painel de busca de hiperparâmetros, construído como o painel Live Preview.

records.context: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host application view's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host application views embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask application view embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask application view's says "Live".
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host screen's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host screens embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask screen embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask screen's says "Live".
records.translation: Estruturalmente, este é o irmão de :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: um :class:`QWidget` autocontido que é dono dos próprios controles, executa o trabalho caro em uma :class:`QThread`, transmite os resultados de volta por sinais, informa toda falha no próprio painel (nunca em um modal — um QMessageBox trava uma execução sem interface) e envia uma configuração escolhida de volta para o painel de configurações da tela host por meio de um callback que o host registra. As telas host o incorporam com :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exatamente como a tela Mask incorpora a pré-visualização ao vivo, e o alternam com um rótulo que diz "Hyperparameter search" onde o da tela Mask diz "Live".

records.context: The panel does not report only a winner. The table is ordered by the criterion the user picked, and the panel also draws the small-multiples panel (embeddings for UMAP, score-versus-trial with the noise band for the machine-learning classification models) and prints the spread, the within-noise flag and the failure count, which show whether the best configuration differs meaningfully from the others. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel does not report only a winner. The table is ordered by the criterion the user picked, and the panel also draws the small-multiples panel (embeddings for UMAP, score-versus-trial with the noise band for the classifiers) and prints the spread, the within-noise flag and the failure count, which show whether the best configuration differs meaningfully from the others. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.translation: O painel não informa apenas um vencedor. A tabela é ordenada pelo critério que o usuário escolheu, e o painel também desenha o painel de pequenos múltiplos (embeddings para UMAP, pontuação versus tentativa com a faixa de ruído para os classificadores) e imprime a dispersão, o indicador de dentro do ruído e o número de falhas, que mostram se a melhor configuração difere de forma significativa das outras. Consulte :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` para saber por quê.

records.context: **Scan writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` walks a sample of the tree and reads each file's own axis metadata; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a problem — because every problem the plan states is a way for the result to be quietly wrong, and the import is the irreversible half.

records.source: **Scan writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` walks a sample of the tree and reads each file's own axis metadata; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a problem — because every problem the plan states is a way for the result to be quietly wrong, and the import is the irreversible half.
records.translation: **A varredura não grava nada.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` percorre uma amostra da árvore e lê os metadados de eixos de cada arquivo; ``Import`` é um clique separado e continua desabilitado enquanto o plano tem um problema — porque todo problema que o plano aponta é uma forma de o resultado ficar silenciosamente errado, e a importação é a metade irreversível.

records.context: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.

records.context: Hover performance
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Hover performance
records.translation: Desempenho do hover

records.context: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the extracted image region under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the crop under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.translation: Um tratador de hover é executado mais de sessenta vezes por segundo, e decodificar um PNG custa milissegundos, então a implementação óbvia — decodificar o recorte sob o cursor em ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produz um gráfico que fica atrás do mouse. Três medidas mantêm o hover responsivo:

records.context: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.translation: A nuvem de pontos é pintada uma vez em um pixmap e copiada para a tela. O hover repinta um anel, nunca noventa mil pontos.

records.context: Extracted image region paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a key-value mapping lookup rather than a query.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Crop paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a dict lookup rather than a query.
records.translation: Os caminhos dos recortes são resolvidos para o gráfico inteiro em uma única passada pelo banco de dados no momento do carregamento (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), então o hover é uma consulta a um dict, e não uma consulta ao banco.

records.context: Decoding is behind a short debounce and an LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Sweeping the cursor across a cluster decodes what the cursor *stopped* on, not everything it crossed; an extracted image region already in the cache appears with no delay at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Decoding is behind a short debounce and an LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Sweeping the cursor across a cluster decodes what the cursor *stopped* on, not everything it crossed; a crop already in the cache appears with no delay at all.
records.translation: A decodificação fica atrás de um pequeno debounce e de um LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Passar o cursor por um agrupamento decodifica o ponto em que o cursor *parou*, e não tudo o que ele atravessou; um recorte que já está no cache aparece sem nenhum atraso.

records.context: What is on application view, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.BarcodeSearchPanel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What is on screen, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.translation: O que está na tela, e por que cada parte está lá. A tabela de achados traz a taxa observada e a taxa esperada por coincidência em colunas adjacentes, com a razão entre elas ao lado das duas, porque uma taxa sozinha não pode ser distinguida de um acaso, e este painel existe para impedir que alguém aja com base em um acaso. A janela de texto mostra leituras com suas correspondências coloridas por tipo de código de barras, porque um código de barras caindo nas mesmas colunas, linha após linha, é a evidência que encerra uma discussão que uma porcentagem não encerra. A proposta mostra o valor que o formulário contém ao lado do valor que a busca sugere, para que o que Apply está prestes a fazer fique legível antes de ser feito.

records.context: What it costs. Every file is read inside a submitted job, one chunk at a time, so the interface stays live throughout and a search can be abandoned at any point. Cancelling proposes nothing: an interrupted measurement is an honest partial report and a dishonest recommendation.

records.source: What it costs. Every file is read inside a submitted job, one chunk at a time, so the interface stays live throughout and a search can be abandoned at any point. Cancelling proposes nothing: an interrupted measurement is an honest partial report and a dishonest recommendation.
records.translation: Quanto custa. Cada arquivo é lido dentro de um trabalho enviado, um bloco de cada vez, então a interface continua responsiva o tempo todo e uma busca pode ser abandonada a qualquer momento. Cancelar não propõe nada: uma medição interrompida é um relatório parcial honesto e uma recomendação desonesta.

records.context: The hook is ``done``, not ``reject`` and not ``closeEvent`` alone. Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on an independent execution path -- going behind a window nobody can see; an executing ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead would loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.measure_inputs.MeasureInputsScreen.done#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The hook is ``done``, not ``reject`` and not ``closeEvent`` alone. Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on a thread -- going behind a window nobody can see; a running ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead would loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.
records.translation: O gancho é ``done``, e não ``reject`` nem apenas ``closeEvent``. Escape chega a ``reject``, que oculta a janela SEM um evento de fechamento, e isso deixaria uma execução de medição -- minutos de trabalho, em uma thread -- em andamento atrás de uma janela que ninguém vê; uma ``QThread`` em execução destruída na saída aborta o processo. Sobrescrever ``reject`` para fechar entraria em loop: o próprio ``QDialog.closeEvent`` chama ``reject``.

records.context: **The model never sees the data.** It sees the digest — numbers already computed — and writes prose around them. Then every number it wrote is checked back against the digest, and a draft carrying a figure that is not there is refused: the panel says which numbers were invented, keeps the model's text where you can read it, and shows the sections spaCR wrote from the digest instead. The result of the check is shown in the strip under the tabs.

records.source: **The model never sees the data.** It sees the digest — numbers already computed — and writes prose around them. Then every number it wrote is checked back against the digest, and a draft carrying a figure that is not there is refused: the panel says which numbers were invented, keeps the model's text where you can read it, and shows the sections spaCR wrote from the digest instead. The result of the check is shown in the strip under the tabs.
records.translation: **O modelo nunca vê os dados.** Ele vê o resumo — números já calculados — e escreve a prosa em torno deles. Depois, cada número que ele escreveu é conferido com o resumo, e um rascunho que traz um valor que não está lá é recusado: o painel diz quais números foram inventados, mantém o texto do modelo onde você pode lê-lo e mostra, em vez dele, as seções que o spaCR escreveu a partir do resumo. O resultado da verificação aparece na faixa abaixo das abas.

records.context: Model Compare: run two Cellpose models on the same fields and compare them.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Model Compare: run two Cellpose models on the same fields and compare them.
records.translation: Model Compare: executa dois modelos do Cellpose nos mesmos campos e os compara.

records.context: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. A comparison that differs only in one of those reports "no difference", which reads as "the models are equivalent" rather than "you changed nothing". So the application view shows what actually reached each model, marks what was dropped, and says so in a banner above the numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_compare#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. A comparison that differs only in one of those reports "no difference", which reads as "the models are equivalent" rather than "you changed nothing". So the screen shows what actually reached each model, marks what was dropped, and says so in a banner above the numbers.
records.translation: **A tabela de parâmetros resolvidos.** O Cellpose 4 aceita ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` e ``rescale`` e depois ignora todos eles, e resolve todos os nomes de modelos anteriores ao SAM para ``cpsam``. Uma comparação que difere apenas em um desses informa "no difference" (nenhuma diferença), o que é lido como "the models are equivalent" (os modelos são equivalentes), e não como "you changed nothing" (você não mudou nada). Por isso, a tela mostra o que de fato chegou a cada modelo, marca o que foi descartado e avisa isso em um banner acima dos números.

records.context: **Downloads are off the main GUI execution path, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#5

records.source: **Downloads are off the GUI thread, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.translation: **Os downloads ficam fora da thread da GUI, são atômicos e canceláveis.** Os bytes vão para um arquivo temporário dentro do destino e só são renomeados depois que o checksum é aprovado (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), então Cancel deixa o destino exatamente como estava — nenhum arquivo gravado pela metade com um nome que parece o de um modelo.

records.context: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.

records.source: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.
records.translation: **Nenhum diálogo modal em qualquer caminho de erro.** Uma pasta sem modelos, um checksum divergente, um checkpoint corrompido, um download cancelado: tudo no próprio painel. Um QMessageBox trava uma execução sem interface.

records.source: **Benchmarks are never sorted across field sets.** The results table belongs to one model on one set of fields, and the summary line names the field set, because a score on one set of fields does not carry over to another.
records.translation: **Os benchmarks nunca são ordenados entre conjuntos de campos.** A tabela de resultados pertence a um modelo em um conjunto de campos, e a linha de resumo cita o conjunto de campos, porque uma pontuação em um conjunto de campos não se transfere para outro.

records.context: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pca#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.translation: Uma mudança de filtro **recalcula** a decomposição em vez de apenas redesenhá-la. A PCA é uma propriedade de uma população: o centro, a escala e as direções dos componentes são todos calculados a partir das linhas dela. Manter os componentes antigos e descartar os pontos filtrados desenharia um gráfico cujos eixos pertencem a uma população que o usuário não está mais olhando — os scores continuariam na base antiga, e um agrupamento que se separa no subconjunto filtrado não apareceria. Por isso, o filtro fica antes da matemática, o recálculo tem debounce e o relatório abaixo do gráfico repete o número de linhas toda vez.

records.source: The aggregation runs off the GUI thread. ``pqc.plate_layout`` is a full-frame groupby and ``detect_edge_effect`` a second pass over the result: **487 ms** on a real measurement table, measured, and it fired on every tick of the min-objects spin box. Dragging that box was a sequence of half-second freezes.
records.translation: A agregação é executada fora da thread da GUI. ``pqc.plate_layout`` é um groupby sobre o frame inteiro e ``detect_edge_effect`` é uma segunda passada sobre o resultado: **487 ms** em uma tabela de medições real, medidos, e isso disparava a cada passo da caixa de seleção de objetos mínimos. Arrastar essa caixa era uma sequência de congelamentos de meio segundo.

records.context: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.plate_view.PlateViewScreen.recompute#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.translation: ``recompute()`` retorna um bool que quem chama lê, e ele significa "uma placa foi desenhada **ou está sendo desenhada**", e não "a plate was drawn" (uma placa foi desenhada). As recusas -- ainda não há frame, e uma agregação que falhou -- não mudaram e continuam síncronas, porque a primeira não faz trabalho algum e a segunda é informada pelo tratador de conclusão exatamente no lugar em que era informada antes. Então a única diferença visível para quem chama é que ``True`` pode chegar antes de a grade ser pintada.

What it does *not* show is "0 stale", which would read as *clean*: with no provenance there is nothing to compare against, so the state column says "unknown — nothing recorded" and the note says why.
records.translation: **Um projeto que o registro nunca viu continua listado.** Os projetos são encontrados percorrendo o disco, então uma pasta copiada de um colega aparece no momento em que o navegador é apontado para a pasta pai — com seu estágio, seu tamanho e a data em que seus arquivos foram gravados pela última vez. O que ele *não* mostra é "0 stale" (0 desatualizados), que seria lido como *limpo*: sem proveniência, não há com o que comparar, então a coluna de estado diz "unknown — nothing recorded" (desconhecido — nada registrado) e a observação explica por quê.

records.context: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the main GUI execution path would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the processing session registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.

records.source: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the GUI thread would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the run registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.
records.translation: **A varredura nunca bloqueia a janela.** Percorrer uma pasta de placa são dezenas de milhares de chamadas ``stat``, e fazer isso na thread da GUI congelaria a aplicação pelo tempo que o sistema de arquivos levar. Tudo passa por :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, cujos tratadores de conclusão aqui são **métodos vinculados** — leia a docstring desse módulo para saber quanto custa uma closure conectada a ``thread.finished``. O indicador de atividade em segundo plano acompanha o registro de execuções por conta própria, então nada aqui precisa acioná-lo.

records.context: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole workflows, so its independent execution path can be hours long. Destroying the application view with it executing deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.

records.source: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole pipelines, so its thread can be hours long. Destroying the screen with it running deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.
records.translation: ``_QueueRunner`` tem este widget como pai e executa pipelines inteiros, então sua thread pode durar horas. Destruir a tela com ele em execução apaga uma QThread ativa, ao que o Qt responde com ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. Ele também não passa por :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, então o registro de execuções de todo o processo — e, portanto, o esvaziamento feito por ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` — não consegue vê-lo.

records.context: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred structured-data name, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on application view.

records.source: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred key, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on screen.
records.translation: **Volcano Explorer** é o único caminho para figuras de publicação no spaCR. Seu gráfico vulcão é uma renderização do matplotlib por trás de um estilo de 56 campos que pode ser salvo e recarregado como JSON, com todos os pontos identificados rotulados, cor ou forma definidas por um arquivo de anotação mesclado por uma chave inferida, colunas x/y arbitrárias e uma nova renderização vetorial no tamanho da revista. O gráfico vulcão do próprio painel é pyqtgraph e não consegue atender a nada disso, então o explorador é oferecido no próprio menu desse gráfico como "Publication figure…", já preenchido com o frame que está na tela.

records.context: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression processing session. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the processing session loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression run. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the run loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.translation: **Hit List** exibe uma linha ranqueada por gene para a execução de regressão carregada. Backends que informam valores p recebem valores q de Benjamini–Hochberg calculados sobre os genes testados; backends penalizados, em vez disso, ranqueiam pela frequência de seleção no bootstrap e não informam valores q. Cada linha inclui a estimativa do efeito, um intervalo de 95% quando há um erro padrão disponível e a concordância de sinal dos gRNA quando há coeficientes por guia disponíveis. Os CSVs de anotação são reduzidos a uma linha por gene antes de junções muitos-para-um validadas. A :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` completa é instalada como a aba **Hits** depois de Guide support, acompanha a execução carregada pelo painel de resultados e exporta a lista filtrada exibida como CSV, Markdown ou HTML autocontido.

records.context: Each of the three is also a button on the Regression masthead: the module's own icon with no text, its one-line description as the tooltip, lit on hover in the maturity colour its tile used -- see :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. records.context: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished processing session, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.

records.source: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished run, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.
records.translation: Cada gráfico vulcão mostra uma família de correção. Uma permutação de guias grava todas as famílias de suporte mínimo empilhadas em uma única tabela longa, e ajusta uma família por resposta quando vários desfechos foram ajustados. Cada uma delas é sua própria família de Benjamini-Hochberg, então desenhar a tabela sem filtro coloca um guia no gráfico de duas a quatro vezes, em alturas diferentes, e junta duas correções em uma única imagem. :func:`single_correction_family` é o corte, e :func:`install_correction_families` o coloca antes do próprio ``set_frame`` do painel, para que toda rota para o painel -- uma execução concluída, uma pasta aberta à mão, um pacote solto -- desenhe uma única família.

Two things follow, and both mislead on a plot: the same guide is drawn two to four times at different heights, and two Benjamini-Hochberg corrections share one axis -- so a q-value read off the picture belongs to whichever family the point came from, which nothing on the picture says.

records.source: A guide permutation fits the same guides once per minimum-support threshold and once per response, stacks the lot into one long table, and corrects each stack separately. Two things follow, and both mislead on a plot: the same guide is drawn two to four times at different heights, and two Benjamini-Hochberg corrections share one axis -- so a q-value read off the picture belongs to whichever family the point came from, which nothing on the picture says.
records.translation: Uma permutação de guias ajusta os mesmos guias uma vez por limiar de suporte mínimo e uma vez por resposta, empilha tudo em uma única tabela longa e corrige cada pilha separadamente. Duas coisas decorrem disso, e ambas enganam em um gráfico: o mesmo guia é desenhado de duas a quatro vezes, em alturas diferentes, e duas correções de Benjamini-Hochberg compartilham um eixo -- então um valor q lido na imagem pertence à família de onde o ponto veio, o que nada na imagem informa.

records.translation: Ele também é citado em ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` e em :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`. As três chamadas chegam a esta função, e ela registra uma única vez.

records.context: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_cellpose#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.translation: Quando a aba ativa muda, as configurações citadas pelo mapa de propagação ``cellpose_masks`` em :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` são copiadas para a aba de destino quando essa aba expõe a configuração correspondente. ``src`` e ``model_name`` não são copiados. Ao entrar em Apply, a bancada procura em ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` checkpoints cujos nomes começam com o ``model_name`` da aba Train. Ela prefere checkpoints concluídos aos checkpoints periódicos ``_epoch_`` e seleciona o candidato modificado mais recentemente do grupo preferido. Se encontrado, esse caminho é atribuído a ``custom_model``, que :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolve antes de ``model_name``; caso contrário, Apply mantém a seleção de modelo atual.

records.source: **The diff is bucketed, never flat.** It renders :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`, which reuses the provenance bucketing from :mod:`spacr.run_journal`: environment drift (paths, hosts, worker counts) is shown in its own bucket instead of being counted as something the user changed, and schema drift is summarised. When two runs match, the table says "no differences" in words rather than going blank.
records.translation: **A diferença é agrupada em categorias, nunca plana.** Ela renderiza :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`, que reutiliza o agrupamento de proveniência de :mod:`spacr.run_journal`: a variação de ambiente (caminhos, hosts, número de workers) aparece em sua própria categoria, em vez de ser contada como algo que o usuário mudou, e a variação de esquema é resumida. records.context: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` sets ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` and a white palette, and the figure carries a solid ``facecolor``. Three opaque things stacked: the area right of "Runs found" was a flat dark rectangle whatever the page-opacity slider said, with square corners where every other container on the page has rounded ones.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare.panel_canvas_class#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` sets ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` and a white palette, and the figure carries a solid ``facecolor``. Three opaque things stacked: the area right of "Runs found" was a flat dark rectangle whatever the page-opacity slider said, with square corners where every other container on the page has rounded ones.
records.translation: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` define ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` e uma paleta branca, e a figura tem um ``facecolor`` sólido. Três coisas opacas empilhadas: a área à direita de "Runs found" era um retângulo escuro liso, independentemente do controle de opacidade da página, com cantos retos onde todos os outros contêineres da página têm cantos arredondados.

records.context: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare.panel_canvas_class#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.translation: O QSS não consegue resolver isso — um widget com ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` nunca deixa o fundo da folha de estilo aparecer, e uma folha de estilo não consegue arredondar um canvas que o matplotlib desenha de borda a borda. Por isso, o painel é desenhado em ``paintEvent``, por baixo da figura, e o patch da própria figura é tornado totalmente transparente para que o painel seja o que aparece.
